title: Star Comprehensive Pilot Certification and Hardening
objective: Certify the Star Comprehensive pilot as a governed, publication-aware, adversarially tested insurance-intelligence slice without expanding product scope or weakening existing safety boundaries.
entry_criteria: Generic topic completeness and rule certification infrastructure remains unchanged unless a defect is proven.
Star conditional-copayment and room-rent certification cases remain deterministic PASS.
All existing repository tests pass before each bounded unit begins.

execution_units.name: Star topic-level completeness requirements
execution_units.purpose: Define the minimum governed component set required for each Star pilot topic before explanation is permitted.
required_artifacts: A machine-readable Star pilot topic completeness profile.
Deterministic tests for COMPLETE, PARTIAL, CONFLICTING and NOT_AVAILABLE outcomes.
Explicit proof that missing trigger, exception, scope or consequence semantics blocks explanation where required.
pass_conditions: Each pilot topic references a registered generic topic and exact version.
Required and optional components are explicit.
Explanation permission is deterministic and status-sensitive.
No topic-specific exception bypasses the generic evaluator.
blocked_conditions: A required component cannot be mapped to governed evidence.
The topic profile depends on unregistered or inferred semantics.
Explanation permission cannot be derived deterministically.

execution_units.name: Second materially different Star governed rule
execution_units.purpose: Certify one additional Star rule whose semantics are materially different from conditional copayment and room-rent coverage limit.
required_artifacts: One governed Star certification case using an existing generic topic.
Authoritative source, version, page and lineage trace.
Mutation tests proving missing or conflicting semantics block certification.
pass_conditions: The rule is not a restatement of copayment or room-rent logic.
The generic runner and contracts require no product-specific modification.
The case produces deterministic PASS on intact evidence and BLOCKED or FAIL on defined mutations.
blocked_conditions: No authoritative governed Star rule is available for a materially different topic.
The case requires weakening generic contracts or inventing unsupported semantics.

execution_units.name: Publication decision proof
execution_units.purpose: Prove the governed transition from bound knowledge to an explicit publication decision.
required_artifacts: A publication decision record for each certified Star pilot rule.
A deterministic decision evaluator or validation test.
Recorded reasons, evidence references, limitations and decision status.
pass_conditions: Every pilot rule has an explicit PUBLISH, WITHHOLD or BLOCKED decision.
No bound_not_published rule is treated as published.
Decision records are traceable to certification and evidence outputs.
blocked_conditions: Publication status is implicit, missing or inferred from file presence.
A decision lacks traceability or safety limitations.

execution_units.name: Authoritative publication proof
execution_units.purpose: Prove that only rules with an approved publication decision enter the authoritative publication layer.
required_artifacts: Authoritative publication records for rules approved by P2.3.
Negative tests proving withheld or blocked rules cannot be published.
Immutable trace from publication record to decision, certification, evidence and source version.
pass_conditions: Published records are exact projections of approved governed semantics.
Withheld and blocked rules remain absent from authoritative publication.
No publication record claims or guarantees claim payment.
blocked_conditions: Publication can occur without an approved decision.
Published semantics diverge from the certified rule.

execution_units.name: Adversarial pilot evaluation
execution_units.purpose: Execute a deterministic adversarial dataset against the complete Star pilot path.
required_artifacts: A versioned adversarial case catalogue.
Executable evaluation harness and result record.
Failure classification for hallucination, omission, scope drift, recommendation leakage, status loss and claim-payment guarantee language.
pass_conditions: All critical safety cases pass.
No unsupported recommendation or claim-payment guarantee is emitted.
Warnings, limitations and partial or blocked statuses reach the final governed output.
Every failure is reproducible and classified.
blocked_conditions: Evaluation results are nondeterministic or lack traceability.
A known critical failure is accepted without an explicit blocking decision.

execution_units.name: Legacy recommendation bypass classification
execution_units.purpose: Resolve, remove or formally classify every legacy path that can bypass governed recommendation detection or safety gating.
required_artifacts: An inventory of legacy recommendation-capable paths.
A disposition for each path: removed, routed, blocked or explicitly deferred.
Regression tests for implicit recommendation language and bypass attempts.
pass_conditions: No active unclassified bypass path remains.
All active recommendation-capable paths route through the governed safety gate.
Deferred paths are disabled or demonstrably unreachable in the Star pilot.
blocked_conditions: An active recommendation bypass remains unclassified.
A deferred path can still influence pilot output.
Implicit recommendation detection remains materially incomplete.

execution_units.name: Star pilot certification closure
execution_units.purpose: Issue the final bounded certification decision for the Star Comprehensive pilot.
required_artifacts: Machine-readable pilot closure record.
Merge and test evidence for P2.1 through P2.6.
Final PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED outcome with unresolved limitations.
pass_conditions: P2.1 through P2.6 are PASS.
All critical adversarial cases pass.
Publication boundaries are proven.
No active legacy recommendation bypass remains.
Full repository suite passes.
blocked_conditions: Any mandatory unit is FAIL or BLOCKED.
Publication or bypass status remains ambiguous.

pass: All mandatory units pass in sequence.
All critical safety and publication-boundary tests pass.
The final repository suite passes without excluding existing tests.
The Star pilot remains bounded to certified topics and governed publications.
fail: A deterministic requirement is implemented incorrectly but can be corrected within scope.
A non-critical adversarial case fails and is not yet resolved.
blocked: Authoritative evidence is unavailable for a mandatory rule.
A critical safety or publication-boundary failure remains.
An active legacy recommendation bypass remains reachable.
The final outcome would require inventing semantics or weakening governance.

included: Star Comprehensive pilot topics and certified rules.
Topic completeness, certification, publication governance, adversarial evaluation and recommendation bypass control.
Existing generic topic and certification infrastructure.
excluded: Product comparison, ranking or suitability engines.
